heroHeadline: Russia Bombards 9 Ukrainian Cities Overnight as Ukraine Strikes Russian Command Posts Near Donetsk
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,646, Russia launched a 'massive' overnight barrage on nine Ukrainian cities into Aug 27 using Iskander-M/KN-23 ballistic missiles, an Onyx anti-ship missile, and roughly 258 drones; Ukraine's Air Force intercepted or suppressed most of them, but strikes still hit four Kyiv districts (sports complex, school, medical facility) and killed 2 people in Zaporizhzhia and Kherson regions, with 14+ wounded nationwide and a heat plant knocked offline in Kherson. Ukraine's Defense Forces answered by striking Russia's main and reserve command posts near occupied Donetsk with air-launched cruise missiles on Aug 26 into Aug 27, alongside strikes on a UAV control post in Olenivka and a repair unit near Chongar. Russian military losses reached ~1,482,150 since 2022 per the Ukrainian General Staff, an increase of ~1,400 in the latest 24 hours.
footerNote: Data sourced from official government reports, UN monitoring missions, major international outlets, and institutional analyses. Historical data draws on peer-reviewed scholarship. Casualty figures are contested; ranges reflect scholarly and official estimates.
